children.guidance:
The quantity SHALL be present.
The unit sub-element SHALL be out of the “KSA Medication Quantity Unit” Value Set.
The unit sub-element SHALL correspond to one of the following:
The Pharmaceutical Dose Form of the Medicinal Product.
The unit of the strength (only possible, if there is only 1 active substance).
The Package Form.
Examples:
250ml (if the Pharmaceutical Dose Form is “solution”).
100mg (if the strength of the medication is in mg, e.g. 25mg).
3 (if a product has a Package Form “bottle”).

100mg (if the strength of the medication is in mg, e.g. 25mg).
3 (if a product has a Package Form “bottle”).
The unit sub-element SHALL be out of the "KSA Medication Quantity Unit" Value Set.

children.guidance:
The “Amount of units of the consumable” to be dispensed element describes the quantity of the Medicinal Product (Medicine) prescribed.
The unit sub-element SHALL be out of the “KSA Medication Quantity Unit” value-set.
The unit sub-element SHALL correspond to one of the following:
The Pharmaceutical Dose Form of the Generic.
The unit of the strength (only possible, if there is only 1 active substance).
The Package Form (only possible, if a specific product is requested).
Examples:
250ml (if the Pharmaceutical Dose Form is “solution”).
100mg (if the strength of the medication is in mg, e.g. 25mg).
3 (if a product is requested with Package Form “bottle”).

An “as needed” flag MAY be present and SHALL be set to “true”.
If present, this indicates that the intake only has to be performed if needed and up to the maximum the Dosage Instructions specifiy.
Example:
If a medication is provided with a Dosing Instruction of “3 times per day” (Normal Dosing) and the “as needed” flag is set to “true”, the patient may take the medication if needed, up to “3 times per day”.

Prescription Item is suspended
completed

cancelled
Prescription Item is cancelled before any dispensations have occurred

active
Prescription Item is not fully dispensed (this value has also to be set to resume a prescription after “on-hold”)
on-hold
Prescription Item is suspended
completed

cancelled
Prescription Item is cancelled before any dispensations have occurred
stopped
Prescription Item is stopped, after dispensation(s) already occurred, but before all of the dispensations occurred.

3 (if a product is requested with Package Form “bottle”)

It is represented as period, where both start and end SHALL be present.

“Period” format:
Both start and end date SHALL be present.
“Duration” format:
The duration value SHALL be present.
